title: You Are Not a Lottery Ticket
coreMove: Replace lottery-ticket thinking with a definite plan that can shape uncertain outcomes.
sourcePressure: The chapter pushes against luck-only explanations and argues that uncertainty is not the same as helplessness; planning still changes the odds and the path. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Pretending planning guarantees success or, on the other side, treating uncertainty as fatalism.
